**Finding: compliant** (NONCOMPETE — no redline proposed)

The agreement imposes no non-compete, exclusivity, or field-of-use restriction on Corio:

- **§2.7 Restrictions (p0042)** — confined to copying/reverse-engineering the licensed Software; standard IP protection, not a business restraint.
- **"Corio Market Segment" / "Territory" (p0013, p0024)** — license-scope delimiters, not covenants; §2.10 even gives us a path to worldwide expansion with consent not to be unreasonably withheld.
- **§13.6 (p0117)** — expressly preserves each party's independent development rights, which is affirmatively favourable to us.
- **Exhibit D** — sales and marketing cooperation is stated to be non-binding.
- **§14.1** — the only "competitor" reference is a mutual assignment-consent trigger, not an operating restriction.

This sits at the preferred position, so no changes were requested.
